name: Precious Love
source:
It is the end of November, everyone's preparing for Christmas...

What I, Ogata Kousuke, set out to do this year is clear. I'm calm and composed - for now.

It is something I have decided to do when my little sister Tomomi and I had a chat about what we'll do for Christmas. During that time, we got into a quarrel and I spontaneously declared to her that I will try to "get myself a girlfriend until christmas."

The last winter of my school life has arrived...

Will the snow thaw by spring for me...?

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20131101112507/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/pl/index.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
十一月底了，大家都在准备过圣诞节……

我绪方康介今年的计划很明确。我现在很平静。

当我和妹妹Tomomi讨论圣诞节要做什么时，我就决定要做这件事。那段时间，我们吵了一架，我不约而同地向她宣称，我会努力“给自己找个女朋友，直到圣诞节”。

学校生活的最后一个冬天已经到来了……

到了春天，雪会为我融化吗……？

[翻译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20131101112507/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/pl/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
